notes:
Account snapshot: midsize product analytics SaaS building an in-app assistant + document search. Team is product-led; trying to move from Hosted API trial to Dedicated for predictability.

Engagement timeline (key items):
- 2026-02-10: Kickoff call (AE Miguel S., SE Priya R.). Agreed to 3-week Hosted API trial focused on chat and search.
- 2026-02-12: Sent onboarding + quickstart (api keys, sample prompts). Drive: Redwood-Pricing-1-pager.pdf linked.
- 2026-02-18: First POC sync (ff_20260302_gh73kq) — preliminary latency good, asked about quantization and model variants.
- 2026-03-01: Mid-trial check (ff_20260309_qw44bp). They shared traffic logs and token histograms; raised cost concerns.
- 2026-03-05: Hosted trial concluded; internal readout done.

Hosted API trial (observed metrics):
- Trial period: 2026-02-10 to 2026-03-05.
- Traffic mix: ~60% chat (interactive sessions), ~30% embeddings for search, ~10% reranking/batch scoring.
- Avg QPS (baseline): 12 req/s. Peak observed QPS: 85 req/s during product launch test.
- Concurrency: typical 3-6 concurrent streams, peak 9.
- Token mix: avg 340 tokens per request (prompt ~60 tokens, completion ~280 tokens). 95th percentile tokens ~1,200 (long summaries).
- Latency (hosted): median 140ms per token; 95th pct latency for full responses ~220ms.
- Cost: hosted burn exceeded expectations; looking to reduce per-token unit cost via Dedicated + batching/caching.

Business ask: Dedicated capacity sizing + traffic forecast guidance. They want a deterministic pricing path (reserved vs burst) and recommended GPU footprint.

Customer requirements & priorities:
- Predictable cost per 1M tokens and committed monthly spend windows.
- VPC deployment and SOC2+ audit logging; KMS integration required.
- Fast failover/fallback: prefer automatic routing to cheaper model variant if capacity constrained.
- Quality retention: cannot accept >3% degradation vs baseline LLM outputs.
- Data residency: US-only logs and keying for now.

Internal engineering notes (SE):
- Based on trial traffic + 3x growth forecast, they expect sustained QPS ~40 and peak bursts to 120 QPS within 3 months after GA. Concurrency target ~12.
- Token mix trending to longer completions as in-product assistant expands; plan for average 450 tokens/req over next quarter.
- Suggested Dedicated baseline: 3 x 80GB GPUs (or equivalent A100-class) with autoscale headroom (one additional GPU warm standby) plus prefix caching for common prompts.
- Batching strategy: continuous batching with small max latency (50ms) for chat to reduce per-token cost; embeddings workloads can be pooled on separate dedicated instances.

Pricing conversation notes:
- Customer seeks 12-month reserved pricing and an option for limited burst credits for marketing spikes.
- Target ARR band they are comfortable with: $75k–$150k/year for committed Dedicated capacity + usage overage.
- They asked: "Can we get an explicit per-1M-token figure for the config you recommend?" (actionable item).

Security / procurement status:
- Sent security FAQ and SOC2 artifacts 2026-03-02. Legal to review data residency and indemnity clauses; procurement window expected 3/22 decisioning.
- Open support ticket SEC-2109: KMS integration questions; INF-4821: latency outlier report from trial.

Quotes / customer voice:
- "We like the console telemetry — helps us understand token mix — but need a better predictive cost model."
- "If Dedicated can shave ~30% off our token cost and give predictable SLAs, we'll move forward."

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-15: Technical sizing workshop with SE + infra (Priya to lead).
- Provide Dedicated pricing worksheet + per-1M-token cost estimate by 2026-03-17.
- Legal/security: customer to start vendor questionnaire; Redwood to provide KMS integration notes (drive link).
- Post-sizing: draft SOW for 12-month reserved capacity option.

Action items (owner):
- SE (Priya Raman): run capacity model + recommended GPU config; propose batching/caching knobs.
- AE (Miguel Santos): prepare committed pricing options and renewal cadence.
- Solutions: draft sample SLA for fallback routing and model degradation guardrails.

Summary: strong product fit for Dedicated after Hosted trial. Primary open items are final QPS/concurrency confirmation, legal/data residency language, and precise per-token pricing for recommended config.
